label: Status quo (Oct 2026)
basis: China: Section 301 List 3 25% + forced-labor Section 301 12.5%. Vietnam: forced-labor Section 301 12.5%. Mexico: USMCA-qualifying goods exempt. MFN on HTS 4819.20 is free.

label: Relief
basis: Forced-labor Section 301 tariffs are struck down or dropped (court challenge pending); China List 3 stays

label: Overcapacity tariffs
basis: Excess-capacity Section 301 (16 economies incl. China and Vietnam; paper sector named) adds 25 points on China and 10 on Vietnam; USMCA goods stay exempt

label: USMCA friction
basis: US declined to renew USMCA in July 2026; Mexican cartons lose preference and pay the 10% Section 301 rate
